market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver at $32 would need a 275% rise to $120 in ~14 months, an extreme move that has no close analogue in recent decades (the 2010-2011 bull run peaked near a 3x gain from its start). A rally of that magnitude would require a financial crises or hyperinflation far more severe than currently expected, making the true probability closer to 0.25% than the market's 6.6%.
evidence_points: Silver spot ~$32 (Apr 2025); $120 target is ~3.75x current price, far exceeding the 2010-11 run's 3x peak in a comparable timeframe.
All-time nominal high near $50 (1980), so $120 would be 2.4x that record; the move is historically unprecedented for the modern era.
No consensus forecast from major banks or industry bodies expects silver above $50 by mid-2026; bullish scenarios top out at $40-50.
sources_consulted: Silver spot price and historical data (e.g., Kitco)
